phrases.text: Question 2 concerns resilient infrastructure for shelter and equity bonds, or RISE bonds.
Today, the constitution limits county debt, with exceptions.
The Legislature would have to let counties issue RISE bonds for improvements in designated districts.
Only growth in district property tax revenue would repay RISE bonds, not higher rates.
RISE bonds would not count toward county debt limits.
The 2026 Voter Guide does not include a cost estimate for the amendment.
Hawaii's voter guide includes no official argument for the amendment.
Hawaii's voter guide includes no official argument against the amendment.
A yes vote directs the Legislature to allow RISE bonds.
A no vote leaves the constitution without RISE bonds.
To pass, yes votes need a majority of yes and no votes, and at least half of all votes cast, including blank votes and overvotes.
